Subject: Novus Engagement — proposed multi-timezone cadence & calendar holds

Hi Daniel / Maya,

Great to connect last week — excited to get the Novus exec workshop on the calendar. To make planning easier across your embedded EMEA/APAC/US teams, I'm proposing a flexible two-day cadence with calendar holds covering region-bridges. High-level ask: can you confirm preferred dates (see two options below) and whether you want the onsite portion in SF or the hybrid model (3 in-person Redwood leads + remote attendees).

Proposal (two options):
- Option A: Tue 2026-04-06 (US late-morning PT) + Wed 2026-04-07 (EMEA afternoon bridge) — single half-day core sessions each day, with overlap windows for exec Q&A.
- Option B: Wed 2026-04-14 + Thu 2026-04-15 — similar structure but avoids your quarter close on 4/8.

Please share: ideal date option, expected headcount (onsite vs remote), and whether we should hold hotel room blocks for traveling Novus staff. I'll drop preliminary calendar holds after your confirmation; Marissa will own onsite logistics and Vanessa will coordinate exec availability.

Attached: light agenda template (v1) for discussion.

Thanks,
Soojin
Soojin Lee

Hi Soojin — thanks, this looks promising. Quick constraints from our side:
- Headcount: ~12 total (3 Novus execs onsite if you choose SF; rest remote).
- Timezones: APAC team can only join mornings PT (which is late evening for them), EMEA prefers afternoons PT.
- Dates: Option B (Apr 14–15) is better — the first week of April overlaps with a finance close.

Can you:
- Share a more detailed agenda and rough travel windows for the 3 in-person Redwood leads?
- Confirm hybrid setup (we'll need a dedicated AV lead and a virtual facilitator).

Also, can you hold both Apr 14 and Apr 15 as tentative until we finalize internally? We'll confirm by EOD Friday 3/19.

Thanks —

Thanks Daniel — great notes. We can absolutely do Apr 14–15 and will hold both days tentatively. Quick responses to your asks:

- Agenda: attaching a slightly expanded v1 that splits the half-day into 3 blocks (strategy, ops integration, live run-through). Marissa — can you confirm AV + room sizing for 15 pax and whether we should reserve a breakout?
- Travel windows for Redwood leads: plan to arrive Apr 13 evening, depart Apr 16 morning (assuming SF onsite). If Novus prefers fully remote, we'll plan for 3-4 hour overlapping windows per day.
- AV/Facilitation: we'll assign a virtual facilitator and dedicated AV engineer. Vanessa — can you flag exec availability for Apr 14 (US execs prefer late morning PT) and Apr 15 (open)?

I'll post tentative calendar holds after Marissa confirms logistics. Daniel — holding both days now; appreciate a confirmation by 3/19.
